svg.title: Preservation and revocation are separate operations
svg.desc: Keep sealed evidence storage and revoked credentials in different operational compartments. Preservation protects a record; revocation removes access. A wipe symbol over both would reverse the meaning.

**Action:** Evidence is retained while active access is removed.

**Caption:**
> STORAGE IS PRESERVED. CREDENTIALS ARE REVOKED. THE KNOWN PATHS ARE CLOSED.
